stage: typed T0 numeric validity and missingness
scope: Local implementation and isolated synthetic software validation; no provider request, bot launch, order or active-model training/promotion

encoding.semantics: Invalid or absent input is zero-imputed with missing=1; measured zero has missing=0. Indicators are recomputed from original raw T0 inputs, never caller-supplied bits.
encoding.domains: Exact binary flags, nonnegative int32-compatible whole counts, signed {-1,0,1} numeric trend, finite float32-representable continuous inputs
encoding.legacy: Artifact feature lists without numeric indicators retain their original matrix interpretation and numeric_encoding=null. Runtime artifacts are not automatically rewritten or promoted.
encoding.storage: Historical/raw Parquet columns and frozen_entry_features_v1 receipt layout remain unchanged. Derived indicators exist only in the consumed matrix.

findings_and_repairs: Universal zero-imputation erased observation availability; new paired missingness retains the distinction for primary and validated classifier/regressor family training and inference.
String false flags previously became true through Python truthiness; binary normalization now preserves explicit false and marks malformed binary values unknown.
Absent or invalid price impact previously looked like measured zero or raised during feature creation; impact_zero_flag now remains unknown unless impact is a finite typed observation.
Explicit false liquidity-proxy provenance was replaced by a true alias through or; fallback now occurs only when the primary field is absent.

Unknown/unrecognized trend previously became observed flat, invalid numeric trends were clipped, and fractional/negative/overflow counts were truncated or accepted; invalid typed inputs now remain unknown.

Normalize all declared raw numeric feature outputs before the unchanged Parquet schema can truncate fractional integer columns or cast invalid Boolean/list observations into apparently measured values; an actual isolated Parquet roundtrip preserves their nulls and extreme finite momentum.
Retain complete raw/missingness pairs when one member is constant, count each varying original source only once, and report the actual number of nonconstant matrix columns.

Bind the fixed version, rule checksum and ordered paired schema in saved metadata; validate before primary/specialized deserialization, same-cohort champion comparison, promotion, immutable primary bundle reads and advisory comparison/rollback.
Include the numeric schema identity in advisory pipeline-v4 fingerprints so changed input semantics cannot reuse an unchanged-data result.
Avoid redundant per-column numeric conversion for already numeric indicators on one-row inference while retaining legacy matrix semantics.

single_row_microbenchmark.method: Local timeit runs; diagnostic only, not production latency or throughput guarantees. Final scalar path preserves each original column dtype despite unrelated complex columns and decoded raw float64 precision until final matrix conversion.

remaining_boundaries: Historically lost observation availability or rounded values cannot be recovered from a zero-imputed/rounded legacy column without original source evidence. This stage does not retroactively certify or rewrite historical raw datasets.
Auxiliary source ages, additional strategy-subprofile descriptors, diagnostic multiclass exit acceptance and atomic multi-head provenance remain separate required work.
